questions.stem: 對偏遠鄉村的弱勢學生來說，由政府提供的免費網路往往比一台新電腦更重要。
questions.answer: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
accepted_answers: For underprivileged students living in remote villages, free Internet service provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
To disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access offered by the government often matters more than a new computer.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾名詞（provided by …）

questions.stem: 然而，這種網路常常很慢，這讓學生很難下載老師在網路上分享的數位教材。
questions.answer: However, such Internet access is often slow, which makes it hard for students to download the digital materials their teachers share online.
accepted_answers: However, this kind of Internet connection is often very slow, which makes it difficult for students to download the digital teaching materials that teachers post online.
However, the free Internet service is often very slow, which makes it hard for the students to download the digital textbooks that their teachers upload online.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（, which makes it …）
關係代名詞子句（省略受格關代）

1.explanation_zh: 「對偏遠鄉村的弱勢學生來說」寫 For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas；「弱勢」是處境不利，用 disadvantaged，不是 weak。「由政府提供的免費網路」修飾語很長，英文把它放到名詞後面，用過去分詞片語 free Internet access provided by the government（網路是被提供的，用 p.p.）。「比一台新電腦更重要」用比較級 is more important than a new computer，computer 是可數名詞，單數要加 a；「往往」often 放在 be 動詞後面。
evidence: 由政府提供的免費網路
1.strategy_zh: 看到「由…＋動詞＋的＋名詞」，先想「名詞＋過去分詞＋by …」的後位修飾；「比…更＋形容詞」用 more + adj. + than。
hints: 切成四段：對偏遠鄉村的弱勢學生來說／由政府提供的／免費網路／往往比一台新電腦更重要
標的詞彙：disadvantaged（弱勢的）、remote（偏遠的）、rural（鄉村的）、student（學生）、provide（提供）、government（政府）、free（免費的）、Internet（網路）、important（重要的）、computer（電腦）
句型框架：For + N, N + p.p. + by … + is often more + adj. + than + N.

2.explanation_zh: 「然而，這種網路常常很慢」：「這種網路」指上一句政府提供的免費網路，寫 such Internet access（this kind of Internet connection）is often slow；中文沒有「速度」，slow 直接形容網路本身，不要寫成 low（low 只形容 speed）。「這讓學生很難下載…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which makes it hard for students to download …；it 是虛受詞，代替後面的 to download …，不能省略，也不能寫成 makes students hard to download。「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」修飾語在名詞前，英文改成後位的關係子句 the digital materials (that) their teachers share online，materials 是 share 的受詞，關代可以省略，子句裡不能再加 them。
evidence: 老師在網路上分享的數位教材
2.strategy_zh: 「…，這讓…」指前面整件事時用 , which …；「讓某人很難做某事」固定寫成 make it hard for sb to VR（it 不可省）；名詞前很長的「…的」改成後位的 that 子句。
hints: 切成四段：然而，這種網路常常很慢／這讓學生很難下載／老師在網路上分享的／數位教材
標的詞彙：Internet（網路）、slow（慢的）、hard（困難的）、student（學生）、download（下載）、digital（數位的）、material（教材）、teacher（老師）、share（分享）、online（在網路上）
句型框架：However, S + is often slow, which makes it hard for + O + to VR + N + (that) + S + V …

traps.literal_error: For weak students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
traps.explanation_zh: 「弱勢」是指資源、家境不利的處境，英文用 disadvantaged／underprivileged；照字面翻成 weak 會變成「能力差的學生」。

traps.zh: 由政府提供的免費網路
traps.literal_error: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, the government providing free Internet is often more important than a new computer.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「由政府提供的」放在名詞前，英文要改成過去分詞片語後位修飾：free Internet access provided by the government；寫成 the government providing … 主詞變成政府，意思也不對。

bonus.text: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, nothing matters more than free Internet access provided by the government, not even a brand-new computer.
bonus.explanation_zh: nothing matters more than …（沒有什麼比…更重要）用否定＋比較級表最高級，not even 補充強調；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「由政府提供的免費網路」中文的修飾語在名詞前，英文改成過去分詞片語後位修飾：free Internet access provided by the government。
1.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「對偏遠鄉村的弱勢學生來說」For（To）＋disadvantaged／underprivileged／poor／needy students（或 students from disadvantaged／low-income／poor families）＋in／living in／who live in／from＋remote rural areas（remote villages、remote rural villages、the remote countryside、remote rural regions、rural and remote areas）。第 2 部分「由政府提供的」provided／offered／supplied／given by the government；寫成完整的關係子句 that／which is provided by the government、that the government provides 也算後位修飾，給分。第 3 部分「免費網路」(the) free Internet (access／service)、a／the free Internet connection、free Wi-Fi、free access to the Internet；網路當主詞是單數（不可數），所以第 2 部分的 is provided、第 4 部分的 is 才會一致。第 4 部分「往往比一台新電腦更重要」is often／usually／frequently more important than a new computer（new computers、having／getting／owning a new computer、a brand-new computer、a new laptop 都可以），tends to be more important than …、often matters more than … 也給分。

traps.literal_error: However, such Internet access is often slow, which makes students hard to download the digital materials their teachers share online.
traps.explanation_zh: 「讓某人很難做某事」要寫 make it hard for sb to VR，it 是虛受詞、不能省略；hard 不能直接修飾 students，make students hard to download 意思變成「學生很難被下載」。

traps.zh: 老師在網路上分享的數位教材
traps.literal_error: However, such Internet access is often slow, which makes it hard for students to download their teachers online share digital materials.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「老師在網路上分享的」放在名詞前；英文要改成後位的關係子句 the digital materials (that) their teachers share online，不能把子句直接堆在名詞前面。

bonus.text: So slow is this kind of Internet access that students can barely download the digital materials their teachers share online.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + adj. + is + S + that …（倒裝的「如此…以致於…」），can barely（幾乎無法）加強語氣；這是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「這讓學生很難…」的「這」指前面整件事，改用非限定關係子句 , which makes it hard for students to …（it 是虛受詞，不能寫成 makes students hard to …）；「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」改成後位的關係子句 the digital materials (that) their teachers share online。
2.notes_zh: 評分說明：第 1 部分「然而，這種網路常常很慢」However（But）＋such／this kind of／this type of／this (free) Internet access（service、connection）、the connection、the free Wi-Fi＋is often／usually／frequently (very、quite) slow、tends to be (very) slow；主詞用複數 such Internet connections（services）時動詞用 are。中文沒有「速度」，slow 直接形容網路本身；low 只能形容 speed，寫 Internet access is low 不給分。第 2 部分「這讓學生很難下載」, which makes it hard／difficult for (the) students to download（which 指前面整件事；it 是虛受詞，漏掉 it 或寫成 makes students hard to … 都不給分）；寫成句尾分詞 , making it hard for students to download 或 , and this makes it hard … 意思相同，也給分。第 3 部分「老師在網路上分享的」(that／which) (their) teachers share／post／upload online（on the Internet），關代可以省略；寫成分詞片語 shared (posted、uploaded) online by (their) teachers 也給分。第 4 部分「數位教材」(the) digital (teaching／learning／course) materials、digital textbooks、digital (learning) resources；material 當不可數名詞用單數也可以。

1.translation: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
1.explanation_zh: 「對……來說」用 For + 名詞置句首；「由政府提供的」用過去分詞片語 provided by the government 後位修飾；「比……更重要」用比較級 more important than；「往往」用 often。「網路」指上網服務，譯 Internet access 比單說 Internet 精確。

2.translation: However, this kind of Internet connection is often very slow, which makes it difficult for students to download the digital teaching materials that their teachers share online.
2.explanation_zh: 「這讓……」承接前一整個子句，用非限定關係代名詞 , which 指代前句；「讓學生很難……」用 make it difficult for sb to V（虛受詞 it）；「老師在網路上分享的」用 that 引導的形容詞子句修飾 materials，「在網路上」譯 online。也可寫成 so slow that it is hard for students to ...。

1.translation: For disadvantaged students in remote rural areas, free Internet access provided by the government is often more important than a new computer.
1.explanation_zh: 「對…來說」用 for 開頭；「由政府提供的」用過去分詞片語 provided by the government 修飾 free Internet access；「往往」用 often；比較級 more important than 接 a new computer。「偏遠鄉村」譯成 remote rural areas，「弱勢學生」譯成 disadvantaged students。

2.translation: However, this kind of Internet connection is often so slow that it is difficult for students to download the digital materials that teachers share online.
2.explanation_zh: 「這種網路常常很慢，這讓學生很難…」自然的英文有兩種：which makes it difficult 的關係子句，或 so slow that 的結果子句；我選 so...that，因為中文兩個分句有因果關係。「老師在網路上分享的數位教材」用 that 關係子句修飾 digital materials，share online 對應「在網路上分享」。

issues_zh: 我的盲譯用結果子句 so slow that it is difficult for students to download…，沒有寫成 , which makes it hard … 的非限定關係子句，所以沒用到 NRREL；中文「這種網路常常很慢，這讓學生很難…」兩個分句本來就有因果關係，自然可以譯成 so…that，題目沒有排除這種寫法。

這個合理寫法不在可接受寫法內：parts 第 1 部分（…is often slow）與第 2 部分（which makes it hard／difficult for students to download）的 accepted 都沒有跨兩部分的 so slow that it is difficult for students to download，學生這樣寫會在兩個部分同時失分，切分對這種寫法不公平。
建議：把 so slow that it is hard／difficult for students to download 補進 accepted，並接受 NRREL 不是唯一寫法（例如把 NRREL 降成加分句型）；或調整中文，讓「這讓…」更明確要求關係子句。
